html:
Santiago is the capital of Chile, in a fertile valley below the Andes. The Spanish conquistador Pedro de Valdivia founded it on 12 February 1541.

Months later the local chief Michimalonco attacked and burned the town, and the Spanish survived a hard winter. Santiago grew as the centre of a farming colony, far from Lima and often shaken by earthquakes. It was poorer than the cities of Peru, and the war with the Mapuche in the south drained its resources.

After independence, won at Maipú near the city, it became the capital of the republic, and grew rich in the 1800s from wheat, silver, and later nitrate and copper. It now holds over a third of the people of Chile. It saw the bombing of the presidential palace in the coup of 1973.
sum: Santiago is the capital of Chile, in a fertile valley below the Andes. The Spanish conquistador Pedro de Valdivia founded it on 12 February 1541.
